#include <cmath>

void run(long total, long p) {
    long studiedCount = 0;
    long remaining = total;

    while (true) {
        long zeroCount = remaining * (remaining - 1) * (remaining - 2) / 6;
        long oneCount = studiedCount * remaining * (remaining - 1) / 2;
        long twoCount = studiedCount * (studiedCount - 1) * remaining / 2;
        long threeCount = studiedCount * (studiedCount - 1) * (studiedCount - 2) / 6;

        long long weightedSum = zeroCount * 0 + oneCount * 1 + twoCount * 2 + threeCount * 2;
        long long totalComb = total * (total - 1) * (total - 2) / 6;

        if (weightedSum * 5000 >= p * totalComb) {
            std::cout << studiedCount << std::endl;
            return;
        }
        studiedCount++;
        remaining--;
    }
}

int main() {
    int totalCount;
    double rawInput;
    std::cin >> totalCount >> rawInput;
    long pVal = static_cast<long>(rawInput * 10000);
    run(totalCount, pVal);
    return 0;
}
